shotSizes.zhUsage: 交代地理环境、孤立感、史诗感；人物小于画面 1/8
shotSizes.enUsage: Establishes geography, isolation, scale; subject under 1/8 of frame

shotSizes.zhUsage: 交代空间与人物全貌；每场第一个镜头默认用它
shotSizes.enUsage: Sets space and full figure; the default establishing shot for a scene

shotSizes.zhUsage: 人物全身入画，头顶与脚下留少量空间；动作戏主力
shotSizes.enUsage: Whole body with small headroom and footroom; the workhorse for action

shotSizes.zhUsage: 膝盖以上；兼顾动作与表情；对话双人镜头常用
shotSizes.enUsage: Knees up; balances action and expression; common in two-shots

shotSizes.zhUsage: 腰部以上；手势与表情并重
shotSizes.enUsage: Waist up; gestures and expression carry equal weight

shotSizes.zhUsage: 胸部以上；对话主力景别，观众代入感最强
shotSizes.enUsage: Chest up; the dialogue workhorse and the strongest point of view

shotSizes.zhUsage: 肩部以上；情绪转折、决定瞬间
shotSizes.enUsage: Shoulders up; emotional turns and decisions

shotSizes.zhUsage: 面部充满画面；微表情、眼泪、瞳孔变化
shotSizes.enUsage: Face fills frame; micro-expression, tears, pupil change

shotSizes.zhUsage: 眼睛/嘴/手/物件的局部；强调关键信息，慎用
shotSizes.enUsage: Eye, mouth, hand, or prop detail; presses a key fact, use sparingly

shotSizes.zhUsage: 物件/文字/屏幕内容；用于信息交付与转场衔接
shotSizes.enUsage: Object, text, or screen content; delivers information and bridges transitions

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 三脚架锁定；情绪戏与对话默认选择；最不容易翻车
cameraMoves.enUsage: Locked off; the default for dialogue and emotion; the least failure-prone choice

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 机身不动左右转；用于扫视环境或跟随横向移动
cameraMoves.enUsage: Pivot horizontally in place; scans a space or follows lateral motion

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 机身不动上下转；用于揭示高度（楼层/站立）
cameraMoves.enUsage: Pivot vertically in place; reveals height

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 物理前推；强调、逼近、压迫感；速度必须匀速
cameraMoves.enUsage: Physically move in; emphasis, approach, pressure; keep the speed constant

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 物理后拉；揭示环境、疏离感、收尾
cameraMoves.enUsage: Physically move out; reveals context, creates distance, closes a scene

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 机身横向平移；与 pan 的区别是不转向
cameraMoves.enUsage: Translate sideways without rotating; unlike a pan the camera keeps facing forward

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 垂直上升；用于场次收尾与揭示规模
cameraMoves.enUsage: Rise vertically; closes a scene or reveals scale

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 垂直下降；用于入场与压迫
轻微晃动；只允许小幅，幅度过大会毁掉整个镜头
cameraMoves.enUsage: Slight sway; keep the amplitude tiny or the whole shot is ruined

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 绕主体弧形运动；角色一致性风险高，慎用
cameraMoves.enUsage: Arc around the subject; high identity-consistency risk, use sparingly

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 快速横向甩动；常作转场衔接，需配合运动模糊
cameraMoves.enUsage: Fast horizontal whip; usually a transition, needs motion blur to sell it

cameraMoves.zhUsage: 焦距变化而非位移；复古感，与 dolly 不可混用同镜
cameraMoves.enUsage: Focal length change, not translation; a retro feel and never mixed with a dolly in one shot

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 与被摄主体视线等高；中性、客观、默认选择
cameraAngles.enUsage: Level with the subject's eyeline; neutral, objective, the default

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 自下向上；赋予力量、权威、压迫感
cameraAngles.enUsage: Looking up; confers power, authority, threat

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 自上向下；削弱主体、呈现脆弱与无助
cameraAngles.enUsage: Looking down; diminishes the subject, shows vulnerability

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 近乎垂直俯视；用于空间交代与命运感
cameraAngles.enUsage: Near-vertical overhead; geography and a sense of fate

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 画面倾斜；用于失衡、精神异常、危险临近
cameraAngles.enUsage: Tilted horizon; instability, derangement, impending danger

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 越过一方肩膀拍另一方；对话戏标准机位
cameraAngles.enUsage: Over one subject onto the other; the standard dialogue setup

cameraAngles.zhUsage: 第一人称视角；用于代入与惊吓
正上方垂直向下；平面化构图的强设计感
cameraAngles.enUsage: Straight down from above; a graphic, flattened composition

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 整体明亮、阴影少；喜剧、日常、安全感
lightingSetups.enUsage: Bright overall, few shadows; comedy, daily life, safety

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 大面积阴影、局部亮；悬疑、犯罪、压抑
lightingSetups.enUsage: Large shadow areas with selective highlights; suspense, crime, oppression

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 单一主光源，方向明确；写实基调
lightingSetups.enUsage: A single motivated key with clear direction; realism

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 背光勾边；分离主体与背景，常用于夜景
lightingSetups.enUsage: Backlight on the edges; separates subject from background, common at night

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 画面内可见光源（台灯/霓虹/屏幕）；增强真实感
lightingSetups.enUsage: Visible in-frame sources (lamp, neon, screen); reinforces realism

lightingSetups.zhUsage: 逆光成影；用于神秘、威胁、身份隐藏
lightingSetups.enUsage: Backlit to a shape; mystery, threat, hidden identity

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 默认；模型对无特效镜头的还原最稳
vfxPresets.enUsage: Default; the model is most reliable with no VFX

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 尘埃/雨幕/雪/雾；同时可作转场介质掩护
vfxPresets.enUsage: Dust, rain, snow, fog; doubles as a transition medium

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 跨镜形变的首选介质掩护（进入 2-4 帧/退出 2-4 帧）
vfxPresets.enUsage: The first-choice morph cover (enter 2-4 frames, exit 2-4 frames)

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 甩镜与快速动作的介质掩护；禁止出现在首尾帧
vfxPresets.enUsage: Cover for whips and fast action; forbidden on first or last frames

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 人↔非人形变的标准介质掩护
vfxPresets.enUsage: The standard cover for human↔non-human morphs

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 遮挡式转场与形变掩护；需与美术基调一致
vfxPresets.enUsage: Occlusion transition and morph cover; must match art direction

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 与水相关的形变掩护；同时提供物理反馈
vfxPresets.enUsage: Cover for water-adjacent morphs; also supplies physical feedback

vfxPresets.zhUsage: 室内↔室外的介质掩护；也可用于时间跳跃
vfxPresets.enUsage: Cover for interior↔exterior; also marks a time jump

emotionTiers.zhNote: 对话与叙述的默认语速档
emotionTiers.enNote: Default pacing for dialogue and narration

emotionTiers.zhNote: 语速加快、句间停顿缩短；同字数需更短时长
emotionTiers.enNote: Faster delivery, shorter gaps; the same line needs less time

emotionTiers.zhNote: 语速放慢、留呼吸；同字数需更长时长
emotionTiers.enNote: Slower, more breath; the same line needs more time

durationTiers.zhRule: 按台词推算原始秒数后，向上取到 supportedSec 中最近的档位；超过 maxSec 必须按 long_dialogue_split 处理，不得直接截断台词
durationTiers.enRule: Derive raw seconds from the line, then snap up to the nearest tier in supportedSec; above maxSec the line must go through long_dialogue_split, never be truncated

notes.zhPriority: 景别 > 机位角度 > 运镜 > 光线 > 特效；预算/翻车风险递增，同一镜内高风险的运镜与特效最多各取一项
notes.enPriority: shot size > camera angle > camera move > lighting > VFX; cost and failure risk rise in that order, and a shot may take at most one high-risk move and one high-risk VFX
notes.zhChainRule: 相邻镜头的景别跨度不得超过两级（如 WS 直接跳 ECU 会产生跳切感），需要大跨度时插入插入镜或中景过渡
notes.enChainRule: Adjacent shots may differ by at most two shot-size steps; a wider jump needs an insert or a medium transition in between
notes.zhRiskScale: low / medium / high —— high 档（handheld / orbit / whip_pan）必须单独试镜，不参与批量生成
notes.enRiskScale: low / medium / high — high-risk entries (handheld, orbit, whip_pan) must be test-shot individually and excluded from batch generation
